officialTitle: Pembrolizumab or Placebo Plus Etoposide and Platinum as First-Line Therapy for Extensive-Stage Small-Cell Lung Cancer: Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase III KEYNOTE-604 Study

design.blinding: Double-blind, placebo-controlled; PFS by blinded central review
design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Of the 453 participants, 228 were randomly assigned to pembrolizumab plus EP and 225 to placebo plus EP.
design.notes: Prespecified one-sided efficacy boundaries were .0048 for PFS and .0128 for OS; OS did not cross its boundary.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding pembrolizumab to etoposide-platinum improve PFS and OS in untreated extensive-stage SCLC?

pico.intervention: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks plus four cycles of etoposide-platinum
pico.comparator: Saline placebo plus four cycles of etoposide-platinum
pico.outcomes: Co-primary: PFS (blinded central review) and OS. Secondary: ORR, DoR

arms.label: Pembrolizumab + EP
arms.dosing: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks for up to 35 cycles plus 4 cycles of EP
arms.doseSourceQuote: Eligible patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to pembrolizumab 200 mg once every 3 weeks or saline placebo for up to 35 cycles plus 4 cycles of EP.

publications.title: Pembrolizumab or Placebo Plus Etoposide and Platinum as First-Line Therapy for Extensive-Stage Small-Cell Lung Cancer: Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase III KEYNOTE-604 Study.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.endpointLabel: PFS by blinded central review; twelve-month PFS estimates shown
outcomes.sourceQuote: Pembrolizumab plus EP significantly improved PFS (hazard ratio [HR], 0.75; 95% CI, 0.61 to 0.91;= .0023). Twelve-month PFS estimates were 13.6% with pembrolizumab plus EP and 3.1% with placebo plus EP.
Although pembrolizumab plus EP prolonged OS, the significance threshold was not met (HR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.64 to 0.98;= .0164). Twenty-four-month OS estimates were 22.5% and 11.2%, respectively.
outcomes.endpointLabel: Overall survival; twenty-four-month OS estimates shown

outcomes.sourceQuote: ORR was 70.6% in the pembrolizumab plus EP group and 61.8% in the placebo plus EP group; the estimated proportion of responders remaining in response at 12 months was 19.3% and 3.3%, respectively.

safety.sourceQuote: In the pembrolizumab plus EP and placebo plus EP groups, respectively, any-cause adverse events were grade 3-4 in 76.7% and 74.9%, grade 5 in 6.3% and 5.4%, and led to discontinuation of any drug in 14.8% and 6.3%.

safety.description: Adverse events leading to discontinuation of any drug
safety.sourceQuote: In the pembrolizumab plus EP and placebo plus EP groups, respectively, any-cause adverse events were grade 3-4 in 76.7% and 74.9%, grade 5 in 6.3% and 5.4%, and led to discontinuation of any drug in 14.8% and 6.3%.

strengths: Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomised phase III design
PFS assessed by blinded central review
limitations: OS did not cross the prespecified significance boundary despite a numerical improvement

clinicalImplications.text: Pembrolizumab with etoposide-platinum improved PFS but OS did not reach statistical significance, so the evidence for first-line chemo-immunotherapy in extensive-stage SCLC rests mainly on IMpower133 and CASPIAN.

tumourBoardPearl.text: A numerically similar OS hazard ratio to the positive trials but a missed statistical boundary: class effect is plausible, but regulatory and guideline positioning differs.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 32468956. No registry ID is printed in the abstract. A later KEYNOTE-604 publication (PMID 37954964) was identified by search but not ingested.
